newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Polling stations open for Moroccan referendum.
newsitem.headline: Polling stations open for Moroccan referendum.

text.p: Polling started in Morocco on Friday at 8 a.m. (0800 GMT) in a referendum to change the constitution and set up a second house of parliament.

White flags bearing the legend "Referendum, 13 September" fluttered in bright sunshine outside booths as they opened in the capital Rabat. There was little sign of early voters in the poll, open to some 12 million Moroccans who have until 6 p.m. (1800 GMT) to cast their votes.
